Alison — thanks for the clear ask. Below is the playbook we propose to hit your dates and keep the evaluation meaningful without blocking launch.

Proposed MAP & close playbook (summary):
- Today (15 Sep): Redwood sends updated MAP + SOW reflecting the canary start window and SLA appendix (attached).
- 16–17 Sep: Legal and procurement exchange redlines. Karthik will coordinate pricing confirmation; Marissa (Legal) will own contract language.
- 18 Sep: Redwood finalizes DocuSign envelope and internal signatory list.
- 19 Sep: Final go/no-go — Orbit confirms exec approval. If green, signatures executed 22–24 Sep.
- Post-sign (week 0): Shared onboarding kickoff (CS lead: Michael Grant), canary with 10% traffic for first 48–72 hours, then ramp to 100% by day 7 if no regressions.

Key asks for Orbit:
- Confirm the preferred signer name & email for DocuSign.
- Confirm whether SOC 2 evidence can be shared by S3 presigned objects (we'll add security contact in the loop).
- Any procurement-specific PO or invoice timing constraints (net terms, billing contact).

I've attached: MAP_Redwood-Orbit_v2.xlsx and SOW_Redwood-Orbit_1.3.pdf (SLA/quantization appendix included).

If you need a compressed signature path (single signatory + DocuSign standard flow), we can route today.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
